results.name: Account switch replaces prior counts immediately and fetches own stats
Late previous account response cannot populate the new account
Returning alpha does not restore a stale count before its fresh response
Plan grant change refreshes counts for same actor
Noncooperating fetch deadline hides counts and aborts request
Loading and missing actor never show previous statistics
Confirmed unlimited quota never displays minus-one allowance

scope: Actual plan screen and actual bounded stats hook with synthetic sessions, readonly replies and clocks. Billing hooks inert in this focused test; no network/generation/DB.
